verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only Cloud Backup for restoring accounts when you lose your phone or get a new device. That is a one-off restore, not tokens available on phone, tablet and computer at the same time with automatic sync. The only other multi-device feature is mirroring notifications to a wearable, which is a related but different capability, and there is no evidence of a tablet or desktop client syncing codes.

support.subject: As an everyday user, my tokens are available on my phone, tablet, and computer at the same time, kept in sync automatically
